what: D-1/R0 deliberate corruption (K-P2Q4.4 (4), D1-1): a branch that changes only a frozen .md file; the ci.yml 'changes' step skips the build jobs, the 'deps' job (no needs/if: runs on every pull request and push) fails on the freeze checks
method: local, script level (the branch cannot be a pull request against main before ci.yml is on main: the diff would include ci.yml). The 'changes' step's run script extracted verbatim from ci.yml and run with EVENT=pull_request over base...head; the deps job's two new steps run as separate steps in a clean worktree (fresh research/.venv with numpy and blake3 only, UV_NO_SYNC=1). The probe branch d-1/r0-frozen-probe was never pushed and was deleted.

probe_1.changes_step: code=false (reports and documents only: build jobs skipped)

note: a first local run reported a passing deps for probe 1: the test script joined the steps with && under set -e (a failing left side does not stop such a list); rerun with the steps separate, as CI runs them. A rerun in the same worktree also showed that 'uv venv' refuses an existing .venv: the step now passes --clear (commit after 3e243af).
